Assam Woman Found Dead in Andhra Pradesh After Train Complaint

An Assam woman was found dead near railway tracks in Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh. She had reportedly complained about drunk men aboard the train she was traveling on. The Andhra Pradesh police have formed a Special Investigation Team (SIT) to investigate the death.
